BASE.rule: Own observed acquisition schedule, byte-equivalent signal rows

E1.rule: Nominal Through green+10%; extra green from same-cycle RED; G onset and nextG onset fixed; Y duration fixed
E1.increment_rule: floor(min(0.1*G,RED-0.1)/0.1)*0.1;0.1s grid and positive RED constraint only
E1.partial_cycles: Unchanged unless a complete observed/edge-extended G/Y/R/G cycle is available
E1.all_red: Not separately observed in modeled schedules; no independent all-red phase changed

E2.rule: Single downstream intersection shift applied equally to both modeled NB/SB phase series
E2.source: B2 REAL complete no-stop Through effective-cut trips
E2.interpretation: CORRIDOR PROGRESSION STRATEGY FOR B2 DOMINANT THROUGH DIRECTION; same shift in B1, no B1 design

E3.rule: Exactly E1 then E2; same predeclared shift, never recompute offset

edge_rule: Nearest complete observed G/Y/R cycle repeated only outside observed clock coverage to support a shifted full horizon; experimental edge assumption, interior durations unchanged

decision_score.DIRECTIONAL_BALANCE: max over NB/SB of mean(travel/BASE-1, stopped/BASE-1); lower is better
decision_score.tie_rule: Pareto first; among alternatives non-dominated in both contexts, minimum equally pooled B1/B2 score with negative score in both; else NO_ALTERNATIVE_DOMINATES_BASELINE
decision_score.robustness: mean negative in both and >50% paired seeds negative in each = ROBUST_IMPROVEMENT; opposite mean signs CONTEXT_DEPENDENT; positive both and majority positive ROBUST_WORSENING; otherwise MIXED

temporal_convention: Earlier t50/t90/final lower=better; positive cumulative departure E-BASE means earlier progression
temporal_censoring_rule: Departure50/90/final refer to full fixed expected cohort; unavailable quantiles missing if horizon-censored, never computed on a smaller completed subset
